verses.text: Clear my name, God. Take up my case against a godless nation. Rescue me from people who lie and do evil.
You’re the God who gives me strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I walk around grieving under my enemy’s oppression?
Send out your light and your truth. Let them guide me and bring me to your holy hill, to the place where you live.
Then I’ll go to God’s altar, to God, my greatest joy. I’ll praise you with the harp, God, my God.
Why are you so downcast, my soul? Why are you so restless inside me? Put your hope in God. I’ll praise him again, my Savior, my helper, and my God.
